verdict.rationale: Jules documents its own repo-integrated delegation mechanism: adding the "jules" label to a GitHub issue assigns the task directly. That covers tagging the agent on a bug thread to delegate it, but there is no evidence of conversational discussion inside the thread or @-mention support in chat tools; Slack embedding is only something developers could build with the API. missing for 10: in-thread discussion with the agent, @-mention tagging in chat threads (e.g. Slack/Linear), independent corroboration of the label workflow

support.subject: As a developer, I can tag an agent in a chat thread to discuss and delegate a bug or task

citations.quote: Use the "jules" label in an issue to assign a task directly in GitHub.
